rationale: Mixed fermentation of glucose, lactate, arabinose, and arginine. Nitrogen limitation (8 mmol available vs 10 mmol needed per g) constrains growth to 0.8/h. Carbon balanced: 101 in, 33.6 for biomass, 67.4 for fermentation products. Produces acetate, propionate, succinate, and CO2 characteristic of Parabacteroides metabolism.
